sign_in.intro: Use your Northgate ID to view your registrations. Your password is never shared with this application.
sign_in.none_configured: No identity provider is configured. Set OIDC_ISSUER or AUTH0_ISSUER in the web application environment.

status_explanations.draft: Not sent yet. Complete the details and documents, then submit.
status_explanations.submitted: Waiting for a reviewer at the organization to pick it up.
status_explanations.under_review: A reviewer is looking at your application and documents.
status_explanations.needs_information: The reviewer needs something from you. Read the reason, update, and submit again.
status_explanations.approved: Your registration for this season and role is approved.
status_explanations.rejected: This application was not approved. The reason is shown above.

applications.heading: My applications
applications.none: You have not started an application yet.

start.heading: Start an application
start.intro: Choose where you want to register and in which role. You can add details and documents afterwards.
start.window_help: Only organizations with an open registration window are listed.
start.no_windows: No organization is accepting applications right now.

application.heading: {{role}} application · {{organization}}
application.documents_help: Choose a file for each required document. Only its name, type, size and checksum are recorded; the file itself stays on your device in this version.
application.incomplete_help: Add your date of birth and every required document before submitting.
application.submit_help: Sends your application to the organization for review. You can no longer change it after this.
application.cancel_help: Withdraws your application. You can start a new one while the window is open.

documents.format_error: Only PDF, JPEG and PNG files are accepted.

review.heading: Review queue
review.intro: Applications filed with the organizations you administer that need a decision.
review.reason_help: Required when you request information or reject. The applicant reads it.
review.start_help: Takes this application under review. The applicant can no longer change it.
review.approve_help: Approves this application for the season and role. The applicant is told and their credentials are checked.
review.request_information_help: Sends this application back to the applicant with your reason. They can change it and submit again.
review.reject_help: Rejects this application with your reason. The applicant is told; the decision is final for this window.
